HOW AN ENGAGEMENT STARTS

What we cover, how we start
and how scope is agreed.

Every partnership begins with a practical conversation about your business priorities before any commitment is made.

01 / INITIAL CONVERSATION

What the first conversation covers

We review the commercial challenge in front of you — whether that is a critical leadership gap, branch sales habits or a workflow bottleneck.

  • Target roles, branch or regional coverage and hiring urgency
  • Current sales, quote follow-up and margin pressures
  • Which workflows (CRM, enquiries, sales or delivery) need clearer ownership
02 / FIRST ENGAGEMENT

What the first step can look like

You do not have to buy everything at once. Most clients start with one focused assignment and connect further support when ready.

  • A single retained search or specialist recruitment brief
  • A targeted sales or branch management coaching programme
  • A walkthrough or pilot of one of the seven business platforms
03 / AGREED SCOPE

How scope and responsibilities are agreed

Before work starts, we set out the exact deliverables, named owners, review dates and fee structure in writing.

  • Written role blueprint, coaching plan or platform pilot scope
  • Clear client and Power-Up responsibilities at each stage
  • Scheduled review points to assess outcomes and next steps

ILLUSTRATIVE JOINED-UP EXAMPLE

A new branch.
A joined-up plan.

SECTOR & TERRITORY EXCLUSIVITY POLICY

When exclusivity applies —
and how it is confirmed.

Selected strategic partnerships can include single-client exclusivity so we do not headhunt for direct local competitors covered by your agreement.

Scope and limits: Exclusivity is never assumed automatically on enquiry. It applies only when we have checked existing client commitments and signed a written partnership agreement defining the exact industry sector, geographic territory, named competitor boundaries, included services and duration.

THE STRATEGIC DIFFERENCE

A partner invested in
your position in the market.

We work across electrical wholesale, technical distribution, construction, M&E, engineering and manufacturing. Each engagement starts with the realities of your sector and the area you want to grow.

Headhunting beyond job boards

We identify and approach relevant passive talent discreetly, using an agreed brief rather than a volume of generic CVs.

Sector fluency

We understand the difference between a branch trading role, a construction project appointment and an engineering leadership brief. The search is shaped around your market.

ONE BUSINESS · ONE AGREED SECTOR · ONE TERRITORY

Room to lead your area.

Our partnership model is built around one client business in each agreed sector and territory. Once the scope is defined in writing, we do not take a directly competing mandate within that boundary. That gives us the focus to help you build a stronger position in your area.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

The questions worth
settling early.

Clear answers before a search or partnership begins.

Which sectors do you work with?

We work with businesses in electrical wholesale, technical distribution, construction, M&E, engineering and manufacturing. We agree the exact market and roles for each brief.

Do you work with our direct competitors?

For an agreed exclusive partnership, we define the sector and geographic territory in writing and do not accept a directly competing mandate within that scope. Availability depends on existing commitments, so we review it before making an agreement.

Can we start with one hire rather than a wider partnership?

Yes. You can start with a focused recruitment brief, a coaching programme or a platform discussion. Any wider support is scoped together only if it serves your objectives.

How is your search different from advertising a role?

We combine an agreed target profile with discreet market mapping and direct conversations with relevant people, including those not actively applying for jobs. We then assess suitability against the brief.

What happens after an appointment?

We can agree onboarding support, leadership or sales coaching, and selected platform workflows to help a new hire and their team establish effective habits. The scope is discussed before work begins.
